BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to processing ballots; and amending RCW 29A.60.160.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.60.160 and 2011 c 10 s 53 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The county auditor, as delegated by the county canvassingboard, shall process ballots and canvass the votes cast at that primaryor election on a daily basis in counties with a population of seventyfive thousand or more, or at least every third day for counties with apopulation of less than seventyfive thousand, if the county auditor isin possession of more than five hundred ballots that have yet to becanvassed. (2) On the day of the primary or general election, ballots must beprocessed and counted until midnight or until all ballots received upto and on that day have been processed and counted, whichever occursfirst. (3) Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays are not counted forpurposes of this section. (((3))) (4) In order to protect the secrecy of a ballot, the county p. 1 SB 5580auditor may use discretion to decide when to process absentee ballotsand canvass the votes. (((4))) (5) Tabulation results must be made available to the publicimmediately upon completion of the canvass.
